purpose: Keep HoloVerse / MatrixCore UI on the red channel and prevent doubled Gleebs dialogue surfaces.
rules: Gleebs dialogue renders on one active red channel only.
Blue and cyan Gleebs dialogue channels are retired and should not be rendered as separate voice overlays.
HoloVerse UI text should use the shared red theme where new or refactored UI is added.
Dimension-specific world colors, bot identity colors, and non-UI art tints are not governed by this contract.
Dialogue must connect to MatrixCore lore context before falling back to generic quotes.
